title: Touring LT
body: At Le Mans in the late nineties, engineers discovered that lengthening the rear bodywork of a racing car didn't just reduce drag. It created stability at speed that shorter profiles couldn't achieve. The Long Tail cars that emerged from that thinking became some of the most distinctive silhouettes in motorsport history. Not because anyone set out to make them beautiful. Because the physics demanded a shape and that shape turned out to be extraordinary. The Touring LT was built in that spirit.
